item.title: [ 62] The Final Console Generation
item.description:
I unironically don't think there's going to be a next console generation.

The PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X is essentially as far as a console can push graphics and performance in today's economy. Taking another step up in tech would require the console to cost way, WAY, more than 1000 bucks (think 1500ish) in order to show off any marketable difference compared to out current consoles. The best hardware deals aren't made by console manufacturers now, they're made by data centers, meaning Sony and Xbox won't get some huge discount on 5080-tier chips they can resell in their machines on the cheap.

The only way they can have any chance at a new console generation is if they pull a Nintendo and instead of focusing on better hardware instead take a step into a new form factor. Or try to pivot in the Apple-direction and make fake luxury tech that's more of a status symbol than anything useful. They could try testing the waters with game streaming again but this has never worked historically and game streaming tech still hasn't improved to the point where it can be compared to local.

As a last note, none of the above applies to Nintendo. They can release the Switch 3 tomorrow with a bigger screen, a slightly cheaper fan and they'll still sell hundreds of millions. Oh and PC is dead and needs not exist anymore. Phonefags aren't real people.

item.title: [ 95] Bad News for MAGATs: Trans hate isn't driving votes anymore
item.description:
https://www.advocate.com/politics/election/allison-montgomery-alabama-2026-midterms

In a historic win, Democrat Allison Montgomery defeated Republican incumbent State Rep. Phillip Rigsby for a seat representing Alabama’s House District 25 on Tuesday night, becoming the state’s first transgender legislator.

According to the Associated Press, which called the race, Montgomery leads Rigsby 53 to 47 percent with over 95 percent of the estimated vote counted. Montgomery is one of three Northern Alabama seats flipped in Tuesday night’s blue wave, per local state publication AL.com.

A software engineer, Montgomery ran on a platform that prioritized affordability and divestment from corporate interests. When she was attacked by Republican lawmaker Scott Stadthagen, chair of the Alabama Republican Party, for being transgender during an October speech leading up to the midterms, Montgomery stood firmly on her convictions.

“I don’t know Stadthagen and he doesn’t know me – this is just plain prejudice... They brought up my womanhood because they have failed at governing,” she wrote in a Facebook post.

In mid-October, mere weeks before the election, Rigsby implied Montgomery’s transness would negatively impact the way she governed and interacted with children. In return, she called out the apparent hypocrisy of saying transgender candidates are a threat to children when Republican Alabama State Rep. Brett Easterbrook was recently charged with first-degree human trafficking. The charge was later amended to attempted first-degree human trafficking.

“Republican politicians always point to vague concerns about ‘the children’ when talking about women like myself, while Republican Rep. Brett Easterbrook gets arrested for soliciting sex with a minor,” Montgomery wrote in a Facebook post.

item.title: [ 44] Rubio, Cruz, Vance & DeSantis make quick moves after disastrous GOP midterms jumpstart 2028 race
item.description:
https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/05/politics/midterms-vance-desantis-rubio-2028-race

Vice President JD Vance’s seemingly straightforward path to succeeding President Donald Trump suddenly looks much murkier.

The Republican shellacking in Tuesday’s midterm elections has quickly triggered a public reckoning within the GOP over Trump’s place in the future of the party — one that threatens to complicate Vance’s efforts to consolidate party support behind a widely anticipated White House bid.

Vance appeared to recognize the danger Wednesday morning, blaming the party’s sweeping losses on the war with Iran and distancing himself from Trump’s unpopular foreign policy decisions. In a lengthy post on X, Vance appeared to sketch out what the foundations for his own 2028 platform, centered on ending the war, tackling affordability, refocusing on domestic challenges and reconsidering America’s relationship with Israel.

“To the people who are just pissed at the results, you should be,” he wrote. “Let’s take that anger and get back to the work of saving our country.”

But there are already signs that there may be a widening lane for someone outside the administration to seize the nomination in 2028.

Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich wrote Wednesday on X that “the scale of the Republican defeat is so great that it makes the race for the GOP presidential nomination wide open.” In the post, he ripped Vance for defending an ad from Ohio Republican gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy that featured the estranged mother of his Democratic opponent, Amy Acton. The ad received bipartisan blowback and on Tuesday, Acton defeated Ramaswamy.

“A good bit of the luster has come off the bloom,” Gingrich wrote.

item.title: [ 44] So, the 30th Anniversary three-volume Artbook is gonna show the original Ken Su
item.description:
So, the 30th Anniversary three-volume Artbook is gonna show the original Ken Sugimori concept art for the Johto Gym Leaders for the first time.
Although not in Teraleak, the existence of such art was obvious since ever, as it was the base for:
-The Stadium portraits
-The anime settei (seen in Teraleak, aside from Falkner)
-The (rarely-seen) colored anime Johto GL stock art,
which all show the Leaders in more-or-less consistent poses.

So far, they teased four of them.
I made this ugly but informative spreadsheet of all known iterations, which should be a hint of how the remaining four look like.

I've no idea why Falkner's anime settei is missing from the Teraleak. But I am sure that somebody (possibly Pokescans) once scanned a Japanese-only book full of settei for the early Johto episodes (I remember it having the settei for the spider creature from Gligarman episode, among others), which probably included Falkner's settei, but I wasn't able to re-find it. I've looked through Pokescans's Tumblr entire archive and found nothing (found only scans from an analogous book but for Kanto), so I'm not even quite sure if it was her (I remember those scans bearing the same "meh" picture quality like most of her pics) but many of her posts were DMCA'd, so anything's possible. Does anyone still have this? I'm mad at myself for not saving it back in the day.

Anyway, do you expect much never-before-seen stuff in the new Artbooks? Or is it going to be a letdown? Do you have any hopes about seeing a specific art or character?

Post your expectations, hopes and fears about the books and discuss obscure or unconfirmed official game art here.

item.title: [121] /out/ings with a Pipe Autumn Edition
item.description:
Last thread >>2868475

This is a thread for enjoying a pipe while doing outdoor activities. If you ask why this belongs on /out/, you've never spent
an evening by the campfire with a pipe silently enjoying the nature around you, and you're missing out.

>how to get started
Purchase a corn cob pipe (or a cheap briar pipe) and a pouch of Half and Half or Captain Black tobacco from a smoke shop
or online. You will need a lighter or match, and something to tamp it with--a large nail works well if you don't have a pipe tool.
Fill the pipe with tobacco, pack it down halfway, top it off, pack it down to 3/4, top it off again, pack gently and enjoy. Smoke
slower than you think you need to, the tobacco tastes best when it is burning cool. Tamp and re-light as needed. If you still
have trouble, try different methods on YouTube until you find one that works for you.
>smoking a pipe will give you cancer
Originally the Surgeon General found that pipe and cigar smokers, following a careful study of the statistics (at a time when
most adults smoked, so they had a good sample size), had insignificant death rate increases. Nowadays, tobacco is being
legislated against while hard drugs are being legalized. Put two and two together. Tobacco is just another good thing under attack by the government.

>muh weed
Not the time or place. Start your own thread.

All tobacco users welcome.
